items.t: Leaking fuel injectors
items.job: Replace all eight fuel injectors
items.note: Price is for a full set; most shops replace all eight. Fuel-thinned oil that damaged bearings raises the cost a lot.

items.t: Air leaks at the fuel filter head
items.job: Reseal or replace fuel filter head and re-prime fuel system
items.note: A seal kit is the cheap fix; a complete new filter head costs more.

items.t: Water pump leaks
items.job: Replace water pump and coolant
items.note: Head gasket damage from overheating would cost much more.

items.t: Overheating while towing
items.job: Replace fan clutch and clean radiator and intercooler
items.note: Includes cooling system testing. A new radiator or water pump adds cost; head gasket damage costs much more.

items.t: Chafed engine wiring harness
items.job: Repair or replace chafed injector wiring harness
items.note: Includes diagnosis. Repairing rubbed spots costs less than a new harness.

items.t: Rusted brake lines can burst
items.job: Replace rusted brake lines (full preformed line set)
items.note: Price is for replacing all the steel lines. Fixing one short section costs much less. Rusted fittings can add time.

items.t: Clunk in the steering wheel
items.job: Replace intermediate steering shaft
items.note: Some shops first lubricate the shaft per the GM bulletin, which costs less but the clunk may return.

items.t: Clogged diesel particulate filter and fuel-diluted oil
items.job: Clean diesel particulate filter and change oil
items.note: A new filter costs much more. Faulty sensors or injectors causing the clog should be fixed too.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace high-pressure pump, injectors, lines and flush fuel system
items.note: Metal debris usually ruins the whole fuel system. Ask GM about any warranty or settlement help.

items.t: NOx sensor and DEF system faults
items.job: Replace NOx sensor
items.note: Includes diagnosis. A failed DEF pump or heater is another common cause. Emissions warranty may cover it.

items.t: Rear fuel tank can collapse and starve the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace rear fuel tank
items.note: Free under GM's recall for affected trucks. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Engine block heater cord can short and overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace engine block heater cord
items.note: Free under GM's recalls for affected trucks. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Rear wheels can lock up (recall)
items.job: Reprogram transmission control software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-797 (26V-083 for trucks repaired incorrectly). Check your VIN first. GM also covers transmissions found to have a bad valve.

items.t: Broken exhaust manifold bolts
items.job: Extract broken bolts, replace manifold bolts and gasket
items.note: Time varies a lot with how many bolts have snapped and whether the manifold is warped.

items.t: Glow plug module can overheat the glow plugs (recall)
items.job: Reprogram glow plug control module
items.note: Free under recall 06522. Check the VIN first. Failed glow plugs are extra.

items.t: Wrong transmission bearing means a full transmission replacement (GM program)
items.job: Replace 10-speed automatic transmission
items.note: Free under GM program N242467600. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Trailer wiring harness can overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace auxiliary battery trailer jumper harness (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 14V-407. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake module bolts can let water in and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace brake pressure modulator valve assembly (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 21V-758. Park outside until repaired.

items.t: Wrong size spare tire can stop the ABS from working (recall)
items.job: Supply correct size spare tire (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 21V-578. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat belt mountings may not be secured properly (recalls)
items.job: Inspect and reattach front seat belt brackets (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-792 or 20V-811. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Roof-rail air bag inflator can come apart (recalls)
items.job: Replace roof-rail air bag modules (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-446, 21V-504 or 24V-756. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driveshaft weld can separate (recall)
items.job: Replace driveshaft (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-650. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake pedal pivot nut can loosen (recalls)
items.job: Re-secure brake pedal pivot nut with adhesive (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-069 or 18V-578. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Software fault can switch off the front air bags (recalls)
items.job: Reprogram air bag sensing and diagnostic module (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-651 or 17V-437. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tire label lists the wrong rear pressure (recall)
items.job: Update engine control software and apply tire label (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 26V-530. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Electronic owner manual may be missing (recalls)
items.job: Reset radio and supply owner manual (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 26V-114 or 25V-815. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Hood may not stay latched (recall)
items.job: Replace hood assembly (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-142 or 20V-324. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power tailgate can unlatch by itself (recall)
items.job: Replace tailgate touchpad switch (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-060 or 24V-894. Check that the tailgate is latched before driving.

items.t: Steering gear shaft can break (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace steering gear if needed (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-549. Check the VIN first.
